hypothesis: Evaluate classical and four-qubit predictors on the stable four-feature L1 subset identified within each prior training fold.
target: NFDB agency-reported size >=10 ha, conditional on eligible recorded fire
limitations: NFDB reported-size proxy; ignition date and final area are not guaranteed.
Source completeness varies; approximately located incidents and identity collisions excluded.
Weather publication latency unknown; retrospective conditional classification.
Exact simulated circuits with classical optimization; no hardware or speedup claim.
Angle scale 0.05 was selected in prior validation; this is an adaptive diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
Kernel normalization differs from the previous raw-kernel screen.
Small capped training samples are a feasibility screen, not a full-data benchmark.
Simulation caches states; hardware pair evaluation costs are substantially larger.
Columns were selected from training-only L1 rankings, identical across all previous folds; this remains adaptive validation on reused years.
Native 1984 cover-water fraction is surrounding map context, not fire on water or event-year vegetation.
rejection_rule: Retain the simplest transform unless paired fold evidence supports gain; no hardware or depth/width search.

encoding_screen.normalization: training-only kernel centering / mean centered diagonal
encoding_screen.rbf_bandwidth: inverse training median nonzero squared distance
